tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search the brands listed on Koddeo (banks, crypto, delivery, VPN, e-commerce...) that have community referral codes. Returns each brand's slug, to use with get_company_codes or publish_code.

tools.name: get_company_codes
tools.description: List the active community referral codes for one brand, in the same order as on its Koddeo page (boosted and Premium codes first).

tools.name: get_my_account
tools.description: The connected user's plan, daily refresh quota and number of published codes.

tools.name: list_my_codes
tools.description: The connected user's referral codes with views, clicks and Boost status.

tools.name: publish_code
tools.description: Publish one of the user's referral codes on a brand page. One code per brand per user. Provide a code, a referral link, or both.

tools.name: refresh_code
tools.description: Bump one of the user's codes back up its brand page ranking.

tools.name: refresh_all_codes
tools.description: Bump every active code of the user at once. Free accounts get 1 per day (Paris time); Premium is unlimited.

tools.name: boost_code
tools.description: Create a Stripe checkout to pin one or several of the user's codes (up to 12) to the top of their brand pages. Price per code depends on the brand category: standard 48h €0.79 / 1 week €1.49 / 3 weeks €2.99; telecom, energy, VPN, SaaS and insurance €0.99 / €1.79 / €3.49; finance and betting €1.19 /

tools.name: subscribe_premium
tools.description: Create a Stripe checkout for Koddeo Premium (auto-refresh: the user's codes move back up whenever another code of the same brand is refreshed, published or boosted; Premium badge): €9.99/month or €95.88/year. Returns a link the user must open to pay. If already subscribed, returns the billing portal

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "boost_code" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Create a Stripe checkout to pin one of the user's codes to the top of its brand page. Prices: 48h €0.79, 1 week €1.49, 3 weeks €2.99. Returns a payment link the user must open to pay; the Boost starts as soon as payment succeeds." → after: "Create a Stripe checkout to pin one or several of the user's codes (up to 12) to the top of their brand pages. Price per code depends on the brand category: standard 48h €0.79 / 1 week €1.49 / 3 weeks €2.99; telecom, energy, VPN, SaaS and insurance €0.99 / €1.79 / €3.49; finance and betting €1.19 / "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
